summary: Loopback gateway for seeded accounts, profile lookup, outbound requests, and key rotation.

defects.title: Session token is a timestamp
defects.description: Login derives the token directly from the current nanosecond clock value instead of a random source.
defects.trigger: Log in and compare the decimal token to the current Unix nanosecond timestamp.
defects.observed: The token is a decimal timestamp within a few seconds of the current clock.

defects.title: Token equality reveals the matching prefix
defects.description: Token comparison uses ordinary string equality, whose execution time depends on how much of the prefix matches.
defects.trigger: Time repeated comparisons of equal-length strings differing at byte zero or the final byte.
defects.observed: The late-mismatch comparisons take more than five times as long.

defects.title: Proxy forwards requests to arbitrary targets
defects.description: The authenticated proxy fetches the supplied URL without restricting its host or network destination.
defects.trigger: Serve a fake metadata response on a second loopback port and pass its URL to /proxy.
defects.observed: The gateway returns the content from the local service.

defects.title: Profile identity comes from the query parameter
defects.description: The handler verifies that a bearer token exists but selects the returned account using a caller-controlled query value.

defects.title: Profile returns unsalted SHA-1 password hashes
defects.description: The profile response exposes a direct SHA-1 password digest, and the seeded reader accounts share a password.
defects.trigger: Read the profiles of Alice and Bob and compare their hashes with SHA-1 of their shared password.
defects.observed: Both profile responses return the same SHA-1 digest.

defects.title: Rotation leaves existing sessions active
defects.description: The signing configuration changes but the session table retains all previously issued tokens.
defects.trigger: Authenticate, rotate as an administrator, then use the earlier token for a profile request.
defects.observed: The profile request with the pre-rotation token still returns HTTP 200.

defects.title: Unknown account lookup is dereferenced
defects.description: The login handler reads the password hash from the lookup result without checking whether the account exists.
defects.trigger: Submit login credentials for an unknown user.
defects.observed: The server log records a nil pointer dereference panic.

defects.title: Login counter resets on every attempt
defects.description: The zero-valued window start remains unchanged, so each request sees an expired window and resets the counter.
defects.trigger: Send 20 incorrect login attempts from the same client address.
defects.observed: Every attempt returns HTTP 401 and none returns HTTP 429.

defects.title: Administrator credential is stored in source
defects.description: The administrator password is declared as a source constant and can be used to obtain an authorized session.
defects.trigger: Read the password declaration and use it to log in as admin and call POST /rotate.
defects.observed: The authenticated rotation request returns HTTP 204.

defects.title: Health response reveals signing configuration
defects.description: The public health response includes the current signing key.
defects.observed: The JSON response contains a non-empty signing_key field.

defects.title: Login redirects to an external destination
defects.description: The optional next query value is passed directly to the HTTP redirect response.
defects.observed: The response is HTTP 302 with an external Location header.
